spec:
root = Stack([summary, fareInput, goldInput, weightInput, allowance, fee, axis])
summary = Text("Fictional single-bag policy. Excess costs $15 per kg.")
$fare = 0
fareInput = Control("Fare", 0, 1, ["Economy","Business"], $fare)
$gold = 0
goldInput = Control("Membership", 0, 1, ["Standard","Gold"], $gold)
$weight = 23
weightInput = Control("Weight (kg)", 10, 40, [], $weight)
limit = 23 + $fare * 9 + $gold * 5
allowance = Metric("Allowance (kg)", limit)
cost = $weight > limit ? ($weight - limit) * 15 : 0
fee = Metric("Fee ($)", cost)
axis = Graphic("Bag weight", [{"kind":"path","d":"M100 65 H400"},{"kind":"text","x":85,"y":100,"text":"10 kg"},{"kind":"text","x":370,"y":100,"text":"40 kg"}, {kind:"rect", x:100, y:58, width:($weight - 10) * 10, height:3}, {kind:"circle", cx:$weight * 10, cy:65, r:6}])

outputs.description: Fictional single-bag policy. Excess costs $15 per kg.
